children: Notice of interim dividend currency exchange rate

Hamilton, Bermuda - The Company announced on 5 August 2026 that the Board declared an interim dividend of 16.8¢ per share to be paid to shareholders registered on 14 August 2026. Dividends will be paid in Sterling unless shareholders elect to be paid in US Dollars. The Pound Sterling equivalent of the dividend is 12.42p per share and is based on the average USD/GBP exchange rate as published in the London Stock Exchange Daily Official List for the five business days commencing on 1 September 2026 and ending on 7 September 2026.
